answer: Quadratic staking at the L2 deposit gate: registering n identities locks n² units of bond. An echo check compares each new key's staking graph to prior clusters, flagging correlated funding paths. A forge attempt therefore needs n² bond to mint n sybils, while honest yield stays linear in n. The yarrow threshold caps any single operator at the point marginal return crosses zero. Break-even lands near n=9, where the ninth bond costs 81 units to earn the same reward one honest key earns.
